mn4:31.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn4:32.1: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha
mn4:32.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn4:33.1: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā
mn4:33.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn4:34.1: siyā kho pana te brāhmaṇa evamassa
mn4:34.2: ajjāpi nūna samaṇo gotamo avītarāgo avītadoso avītamoho tasmā arañña vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevatīti.
mn4:34.3: na kho panetaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn4:34.4: dve kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa atthavase sampassamāno arañña vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevāmi
mn4:34.5: attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno pacchimañca janataṃ anukampamānoti.
mn4:35.1: anukampitarūpā vatāyaṃ bhotā gotamena pacchimā janatā yathātaṃ arahatā sammāsambuddhena.
mn4:35.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn4:35.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn4:35.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn4:35.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti. bhayabheravasuttantaṃ
